about: Curated fixes for gaps in the Spire Codex monster data, each with its sources (read: the page was read directly; otherwise only reported by a search summary). Applied as a catalog layer while the gap remains. See crates/spire-data/src/curated.rs.

sources.says: The Entomancer repeats a fixed three-move cycle: Beeeees!, then Spear!, then Pheromone Spit, and back to the start. Pheromone Spit: Gains 1 Personal Hive and 1 Strength. If Personal Hive is already at 3, gains 2 Strength instead.
Attack Pattern: 1 Pheromone Spit, 2 Beeeees!, 3 Spear!, then back to the start. Pheromone Spit: gains 2 Strength, gains 1 Personal Hive, and gains 1 Strength.
Starts with Beeeees!; Beeeees! and Spear! have no next move.

entries.note: Codex adds both of Pheromone Spit's Strength cases together (+3); the wiki says +1, or +2 once Personal Hive is at 3 (from the third Spit). Modelled as +1, so later Beeeees! are slightly understated.

pattern.description: Sleeps 3 turns, then Slash → Disembowel → Slash2 → Soul Siphon → repeat (curated)

sources.says: The Lagavulin Matriarch starts Asleep with 12 Plating. It sleeps for 3 turns or until it takes unblocked damage, whichever comes first. When it wakes up, it loses its Plating. After waking, it repeats this four-move cycle: Slash, Disembowel, Slash2, Soul Siphon. Soul Siphon removes 2 Strength and 2 Dexterity from the player and gains 2 Strength.
Asleep 3 ('Awakens upon losing HP or after 2 turns.'); awake cycle Slash → Disembowel → Slash2 → Soul Siphon; the sleep state has no next move.

entries.note: It wakes sooner on unblocked damage, which is the player's choice, so the pattern shows the full sleep. Its Plating lasts only while it sleeps.

sources.says: Phase 1: 100 HP (111 at A8+), alternates Bite and Skull Bash. Phase 2: revives with 200 (212) HP, gains Painful Stabs and loses Enrage; uses Multi-Claw every turn, starting at 3 hits and gaining +1 hit each use. Phase 3: revives with 300 (313) HP, gains Nemesis, loses Adaptable and Painful Stabs; cycles Lacerate, Big Pounce, Burning Growl. Each phase loses all status effects, including Strength.
Adaptable revives it; after reviving it uses Multi-Claw if respawns < 2, Lacerate if respawns >= 2. Multi-Claw is listed as one hit of 10. No HP given.
Community runs (beta): 230 wins at Test Subject over six export pages lose a median 29 HP (damage_taken) in a median 9.5 turns.

entries.note: Multi-Claw follows the Codex (one hit of 10, 11 at Ascension), not the wiki's 3 growing hits: community wins here lose a median 29 HP over the whole fight, which decks that block 16-24 a turn couldn't against 3+ hits of 11 every phase-2 turn. Each phase holds the powers the wiki gives it (phase 2: Adaptable and Painful Stabs; phase 3: Nemesis); the turn spent reviving isn't counted.

pattern.description: Bulk → Writhe → Outgas (Constrict in the data) → repeat, each segment starting on a different move (curated)

sources.says: Each segment cycles through the following pattern: Bulk, Writhe, Outgas. Each segment starts on a different move, which will remain the case until one or more of them is killed. When a segment is killed, it uses Reattach to revive with 25 HP provided at least one other segment is still alive.
Moves Writhe, Bulk, Constrict (Outgas on the wiki: 8 damage, 1 Weak); no pattern given.

entries.note: Which segment starts on which move isn't stated; together they always cover all three. Reattach (a dead segment reviving with 25 HP while another lives) isn't modelled.
